method: Each process uses seven calibrated batches after 200ms warmup. Final reviewed-* files use three alternating baseline/candidate/Inkmark sequences; baseline and candidate are copied to an identical executable path and use identical arguments and inherited environment. reviewed-layout-* additionally compares mixed 1 MB at eight padding lengths (0..448, stride64) under CORE_MARKDOWN_BENCH_PADDING, alternating source order. Builds, tests and review workloads do not overlap timing. No CPU affinity or machine-wide isolation.

exploratory_runs.note: Earlier directional measurements before expanded-tab fallback and emphasis regression tests; retained for transparency, excluded from final paired summaries.

notes: Allocation calls exclude reallocations, input loading, and options construction. Requested bytes include growth and are not peak or retained memory.

Reference benchmark output is byte-identical to Inkmark. README and mixed CommonMark benchmark differences are equivalent text quote escaping. GFM differs structurally and is not an equal-output speed comparison.
No runtime dependency or public feature changes. MDX recognizers remain bypassed when disabled; this study measures reference lookup and inline storage, not MDX removal.
Baseline and candidate use identical benchmark adapters. Production source stayed unchanged during final validation and timings.
Do not interpret individual layout-sensitive process timings as a universal source ranking. All initial, repeated, diagnostic and final measurements are retained.
